verifications.claim: TSA wait times often exceed 30 minutes.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: stood in line for nearly two hours (R1); delays of four hours or more (R3); waited as long as 6 hours (R4); wait times at major hubs ... reached two hours (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources provide direct examples of wait times exceeding 30 minutes, supporting the claim of it happening often during the reported period.

verifications.claim: Major hubs report delays of over an hour due to staffing shortages, especially during spring break.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Atlanta ... over a third of TSA staff not showing up; Houston ... 240 minutes (R3); major hubs in Houston and Atlanta reached two hours ... staffing shortages ... spring break season (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly report delays over an hour at major hubs like Atlanta and Houston due to staffing shortages during spring break/shutdown.

verifications.claim: The MyTSA app is the official app.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: MyTSA App | Transportation Security Administration (R2); TSA's MyTSA app (R4); TSA mobile My TSA application (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources from official TSA/DHS sites and reports confirm MyTSA as the official TSA app.

verifications.claim: The MyTSA app provides 24/7 nationwide updates on security checkpoints.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: provides ... 24/7 access to ... airport security information ... Check the delay information at your favorite airports nationwide (R2); provides estimated wait times ... based on average checkpoint data (R3); tracks and updates airport delays (R4); check and post airport delays ... in real time (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Official descriptions confirm 24/7 access to nationwide security wait time/delay information for checkpoints.

verifications.claim: TSA PreCheck has an average wait time under 10 minutes.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No source mentions average wait times for TSA PreCheck, let alone under 10 minutes.

verifications.claim: Some airports advise arriving 4–5 hours early during peak times.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: passengers are advised to allow at least 4 hours or more ... (Atlanta); warning customers of delays of four hours or more (Houston)
verifications.reasoning: Atlanta and Houston explicitly advise allowing 4+ hours during the peak shutdown period.

verifications.claim: Houston (Hobby/IAH), New Orleans (MSY), ATL, EWR, JFK, MIA, and DEN have longer than average wait times.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: Miami ... nearly two hours (R1); Atlanta worst-affected ... Houston ... 240 minutes ... JFK ... significantly longer ... Newark ... significantly longer (R3); Houston ... 6 hours ... JFK ... significantly longer (R4); Houston and Atlanta ... two hours ... New Orleans ... at least three hours (R6); Denver ... maximum lines of just over 20 minutes (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources support longer waits for Houston (Hobby/IAH), New Orleans (MSY), ATL, EWR, JFK, MIA, but directly contradict for DEN which has short lines (20 minutes).
